headline: OpenAI and Microsoft knew they were starting a ‘doom loop’ for the web
summary: Unsealed court documents reveal OpenAI and Microsoft foresaw negative impacts of their AI models. Internal warnings described AI training data scraping as "largest theft of labor." Companies acknowledged creating a "doom loop" that would damage the internet.

headline: Virginia governor creates an AI task force and moves to restrain data centers
summary: Virginia Gov. Spanberger established an AI task force. New executive order empowers local communities in data center development decisions. Order also bans executive branch officials from signing nondisclosure agreements.

headline: Disney’s first CTO is Character.AI’s former CEO
summary: Disney has appointed its first-ever Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Karandeep Anand, former CEO of Character.AI, takes on the role. Anand will report directly to Disney's recently appointed leadership.

headline: The real story of the iPhone 18 Pro’s camera
summary: The iPhone 18 Pro introduces significant camera upgrades this year. A key feature is the new variable aperture main lens. This lens improves low-light performance and offers better depth of field control.

headline: The Blood of Dawnwalker Cost Just $40 Million to Develop
summary: Rebel Wolves' game, The Blood of Dawnwalker, was a September success story. The game reportedly cost only $40 million to develop. This development budget is considered modest for a major title.

headline: Walmart Has a 512GB Nintendo Switch 2 Memory Card for $75 With Hidden YMMV Coupon, 256GB for $37
summary: Walmart is offering deals on Nintendo Switch 2 memory cards. A 512GB microSD card is available for $75 with a potential hidden coupon. A 256GB option is also available for $37, appealing to avid gamers.

headline: The Witch Hat Atelier Manga Box Set Gets a Major Price Cut at Amazon Ahead of Season 2
summary: The Witch Hat Atelier manga box set is significantly discounted on Amazon. This price cut comes ahead of the release of Season 2. Fans can grab the popular manga series at a reduced cost.

headline: Remedy Honors the Late David Lynch in Control Resonant With Powerful Twin Peaks Quote
summary: Remedy's new open-world game, Control Resonant, pays tribute to David Lynch. The game features Lynchian inspirations, consistent with Remedy's past works. A powerful Twin Peaks quote honors the late director within the game.

headline: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland's security
summary: The US and Denmark have struck an agreement regarding Greenland's security. Trump stated the deal grants the US "permanent control" over security in Greenland. Danish officials have not yet confirmed the specifics of the agreement.

headline: 'I'm telling the truth': Earl Spencer defends Diana book claims about Charles in BBC interview
summary: Earl Spencer defended claims made in his book about Princess Diana and Prince Charles. He confirmed Charles's alleged words, "we'll forget her soon enough," were "exactly" used. Spencer reiterated his truthfulness in a BBC interview.

headline: MI5 accepts it gave evidence based on lies in neo-Nazi spy case
summary: MI5 has admitted to presenting false evidence in a neo-Nazi spy case. This marks the first official confirmation of the BBC's prior revelations. The false testimony was used while defending a violent informant in court.

headline: Flight chaos caused by software defect in space of a millisecond, report says
summary: A report attributes recent flight chaos to a millisecond-long software defect. The technical failure resulted in over 2,000 flight cancellations. Hundreds of thousands of passengers were affected by the disruption.
